uncertainties: Story character Chuur is a provisional romanization of Churu pending glossary research.
text:
It's SECRET training!
Yes, yes...
Ooh...
Huh... Class is over.
Why is everyone still
gathered in the classroom?
Oh... Class is over.
Why is everyone still
gathered in the classroom?
...
...
They all look so serious.
What in the world
are they doing???
They all look so serious.
What in the world
are they doing???
...And that was when it happened.
The gunpowder Chuur
kept in his trouser pocket
for playing tricks
spilled from the tear made
by those sharp fangs, straight
into the wicked dragon's great mouth!
The dragon had been
just about to breathe fire,
and its mouth exploded!!
Sent flying along with
a shower of rainbow sparks,
Chuur sailed over the dark forest
and made it safely
back to
his friends.
And they lived happily ever after.
All right, then.
That's the end
of today's story.
That was so much fun! ♪
Hey, when will you
tell us the next part?
Let's see... I'll ask
Chuur about it
as soon as I can, all right?
Okay! It's a promise! ♪
Phew...
Well done,
Teacher Alieze!
Eek!?
T-Teacher...!?
Kyupii! ♪
Hey, now.
There's no need
to scream.
W-w-when?
How long have you...
been standing there???
Let's see... Since Chuur
the pointy-eared fellow went
to pick glowing mushrooms, I think.
Let's see... Since Chuur
the pointy-eared fellow went
to pick glowing mushrooms.
Oh, no...
You were listening all that time...
Ooooh...
Kyupi, pii...
I didn't want to interrupt,
and besides,
it sounded interesting.
Where's that fairy tale from?
I didn't want to interrupt,
and it sounded interesting,
so I couldn't help listening...
What book did
that fairy tale come from?
...
Hm?
I made it up myself.
That story...
You did!?
